command:
set -euo pipefail
printf '[job] fitter Mac ARM proof stack\n'
printf '[worker] host=%s os=%s arch=%s cpus=%s\n' "$(hostname)" "$(uname -s)" "$(uname -m)" "$(sysctl -n hw.ncpu)"
python3 --version
python3 -m venv .runner-venv-ci
. .runner-venv-ci/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements-ci.txt
python - <<'PY'
import platform
import z3
print(f"[python] {platform.python_version()}")
print(f"[z3] {z3.get_version_string()}")
PY
PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/validate_symbolic_methods.py --timeout-ms 15000
for model in   src/clarity/models/thermostat/model.sysml   src/clarity/models/mixing-sysml-model/model.sysml   tests/fixtures/standalone/cruise-controller-model.sysml
do
  printf '[markov] %s\n' "$model"
  PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/prove_markov.py "$model" --timeout-ms 15000
  printf '[discretization] %s\n' "$model"
  PYTHONPATH=src python scripts/certify_discretization.py "$model" --validate-z3 --timeout-ms 15000
done
printf '[job] proof-stack-passed\n'
